stem_book: Oxidation of glucose takes place as follows: C6H12O6(s) + 6O2(g) → 6CO2(g) + 6H2O(g); ΔH = −2721.18 kJ (at 290 K). Calculate the heat of reaction at constant volume at 290 K (R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹), in kJ. (If the answer is x×10³, find the value of x.)
reason: Printed key 2.706 (ΔnRT added with wrong sign) and drops the sign; working: Δn = 12 − 6 = +6, ΔU = −2721.18 − 14.47 = −2735.65 kJ → x = −2.736
